subtasks: Stack the three blocks with different textures.
Use the right gripper to pick up the remaining striped brown block at the rear center and stack it on top of the pale wood and white tower. Open the grippers and return both arms home.
Use the right gripper to pick up the pale wood block and center it on the striped brown block. Release it upright and clear the stack.

Pick up the separate white block with the right gripper, keeping the fingers clear of the nearby tower. Center white on the pale wood block above the striped base, open the hand, withdraw upward, and return both open arms to their starting poses.
